replies.author: BenTheSodaman
replies.body:
I'm not the OP. A quick glance at their comment history, this appears to be a follow-up of sorts to their work on: [https://www.reddit.com/r/prizefighters/comments/1t4ha2f/building\_a\_competitor\_to\_pf/](https://www.reddit.com/r/prizefighters/comments/1t4ha2f/building_a_competitor_to_pf/)

Not sure if this may assist in future posters framing any questions or inquiries for the OP. From what I glanced at:

\* made a browser-based game that is in early development called Fight Life that was inspired by a mobile game called Prize Fighters and Prize Fighters 2, but designed for touch screens

\* they used Vite/Phaser to create their project

\* I think their game is "[https://lattymoy.github.io/project-fist/](https://lattymoy.github.io/project-fist/)" based on what I can find 

(and OP let me know if you didn't want this link posted on reddit in the "dont understand the fetish of one shotting ai game generation" thread a couple weeks ago.)
